# confluent_switchover_endpoints Data Source

[![Preview](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lifecycle%20Stage-Preview-%2300afba)](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/api.html#section/Versioning/API-Lifecycle-Policy)

!> **Warning:** Switchover is a preview feature. Preview features are introduced to gather customer feedback and may change based on that feedback. They are intended for evaluation and non-production use only, and are not covered by Confluent SLAs. Preview features may be discontinued at any time.

`confluent_switchover_endpoints` lists the switchover endpoints in an environment, optionally only those bound to one switchover pair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "confluent" {
  cloud_api_key    = var.confluent_cloud_api_key    # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_KEY env var
  cloud_api_secret = var.confluent_cloud_api_secret # optionally use CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET env var
}

# Every endpoint bound to one pair.
data "confluent_switchover_endpoints" "for_pair" {
  environment_crn    = "crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123"
  switchover_pair_id = "sw-abc123"
}

# The bootstrap hostname clients should use right now (the active side's endpoint).
output "active_bootstrap_hostname" {
  value = one([
    for e in one(data.confluent_switchover_endpoints.for_pair.switchover_endpoints).endpoints : e.hostname
    if e.name == one(data.confluent_switchover_endpoints.for_pair.switchover_endpoints).target
  ])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `environment_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the environment whose switchover endpoints to list, for example, `crn://confluent.cloud/organization=org-abc/environment=env-abc123`.
- `switchover_pair_id` - (Optional String) Only list endpoints bound to this switchover pair, for example, `sw-abc123`.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the preceding arguments, the following attributes are exported:

- `switchover_endpoints` - (Required List of Object) The matching switchover endpoints. Each object exports the same attributes as the `confluent_switchover_endpoint` data source:
  - `id` - (Required String) The ID of the switchover endpoint, for example, `se-abc123`.
  - `display_name` - (Required String) A human-readable name for the switchover endpoint.
  - `parent_resource_crn` - (Required String) The CRN of the switchover pair this endpoint is bound to.
  - `target` - (Required String) The name of the endpoint side that is currently active; follows the pair's active member.
  - `endpoints` - (Required List of Object) The endpoint definitions, one per side. Each exports `name`, `hostname`, `cloud`, `region`, `connection_type`, and an `endpoint_filter` object with `type`, `network_crn`, and `access_point_crn`.
  - `phase` - (Required String) The lifecycle phase of the switchover endpoint, for example, `READY`.
